baseline.source: canon: WFB 8e Tomb Kings (Priest-King dynasties, the Mortuary Cult, legions of the dead raised by Nagash's Great Ritual, which slew Nehekhara's living; the army-book text is from memory, corroborated by Bell of Lost Souls 2025 (Alcadizaar the last living Nehekharan) and Warhammer Community's Old World Almanack (kings bound to their remains))
baseline.why: An undead Tomb King rules absolutely through the Mortuary Cult with tireless legions; with no living subjects left there is no one to enslave, so slavery is banned and undead labour is Mechanics gap #3; no schools or police beyond the guard of the dead

suggested_ig_names.why: Lahmia has been a ruin since the Nehekharan alliance cast out its vampires, and Neferata rules from the Silver Pinnacle; the remnant has no named ruler or cult (names invented).
